The successful candidate will join a team of dedicated professionals who are responsible for supporting military communication products throughout their lifecycle.  As a Product Support Engineer you will be tasked with investigating a variety of problems related to Analog, Digital, and RF.  Candidates with experience in any of these areas will be considered. Identify and drive improvements to HR systems, processes, and overall employee experience

Experience working closely with senior leadership or executive teams

jobs.description:
JOB STATEMENT: 
 
The Database Administrator (DBA) is responsible for ensuring the availability, performance, security, and integrity of Janus International Group’s Microsoft SQL Server–based data platforms that support core ERP systems, operational applications, and enterprise reporting. This role owns day‑to‑day database administration, performance tuning, backup and recovery, and operational readiness across production and non‑production environments. A critical responsibility of this position is to design, build, and actively operate SolarWinds monitoring to provide proactive health visibility, actionable alerting, and rapid resolution of database, job execution, and performance issues, thereby minimizing business disruption and improving platform reliability.
 
 
ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

Administer and maintain Microsoft SQL Server instances supporting ERP, reporting, and operational workloads (production and non-production). 
Perform installation, configuration, patching coordination, and lifecycle management across SQL Server and related components (SQL Agent, SSIS where applicable, linked services, drivers). 
Own database security administration: least privilege access, role-based permissions, credential governance, and audit support for regulated processes. 
Diagnose and resolve performance bottlenecks (blocking, long-running queries, indexing/statistics, IO pressure, tempdb contention, job overruns). SolarWinds alerting practices and blocking visibility are explicitly in-scope for the team’s operating model. 
Create and maintain preventative maintenance routines (index/statistics strategy, integrity checks, job hygiene, capacity forecasting). 
Partner with application owners and data engineers to optimize workloads tied to ERP systems, reporting extracts, and data warehouse replication patterns. 
Build and operationalize SolarWinds as the primary monitoring capability for database and related infrastructure health: deploy/configure, validate data ingestion, and implement dashboards aligned to stakeholder reporting needs. 
Configure actionable alerting for SQL Agent job failures / missed schedules (including critical maintenance jobs and ETL/SSIS pipelines). 
Blocking/deadlocks and recurring performance conditions requiring DBA triage. 
Capacity and availability signals (CPU, memory, disk growth, database size trends) to prevent outages and performance degradation. 
Implement and tune alert thresholds and routing to reduce noise while maintaining urgency for true incidents.
Where applicable, leverage SolarWinds-related tooling discussed internally (e.g., SQL Sentry as an adjunct for SQL Server monitoring/notifications) and integrate learnings into the monitoring design. 
Produce and maintain monitoring documentation and runbooks; complete knowledge transfer so monitoring is repeatable and operationally sustainable. 
Ensure database backup strategy supports business RTO/RPO requirements and aligns with Janus backup policy standards. 
Execute and/or coordinate operational backup tasks and verification expectations (daily review practices, immediate investigation of unsuccessful jobs). 
Participate in/lead recovery testing routines (quarterly recovery tests and at least annual full system recovery exercises, where applicable). 
Support and troubleshoot SQL-side components of integration and analytics workflows that source from ERP/operational databases into downstream reporting and lake/warehouse destinations (including job-based replication and ETL patterns). 
Partner with data platform stakeholders to ensure SQL sources are performant, accessible, and stable for Synapse/Fabric ingestion patterns. 
Maintain accurate inventory of SQL instances, databases, and dependencies.
Create operational runbooks for recurring incidents, monitoring responses, backup/restore steps, and maintenance windows. 
Participate in cross-functional incident response and problem management; provide clear root cause narratives and permanent corrective actions.

 
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

5+ years of hands-on DBA experience administering Microsoft SQL Server in a multi-instance environment.
Strong T-SQL skills: query tuning, indexing strategy, execution plan analysis, and troubleshooting blocking/deadlocks.
Demonstrated experience owning SQL Agent jobs and maintenance automation (backups, DBCC CHECKDB, index/statistics). 
Practical experience designing and operating monitoring/alerting systems (must include SolarWinds or comparable enterprise monitoring platforms). 
Backup/restore expertise, including recovery validation and alignment to RTO/RPO-driven programs. 
Strong communication: able to translate technical conditions (e.g., blocking, job chains, failure patterns) into actionable operational steps.

 
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

Experience supporting ERP-adjacent SQL estates (e.g., environments like Sage 500 / Sage 100 / M2M). 
Familiarity with ETL/replication patterns and SSIS job ecosystems.
Exposure to Microsoft analytics stack integrations (e.g., Synapse/Fabric ingestion patterns, lakehouse/warehouse consumers).

Monitoring specialization: alert noise reduction, routing strategy, and dashboard design for stakeholders.
